C15.content_en:
Ways to check the numbers of one video — and how the main options compare

You found a video that is taking off and want to keep its views and likes on record. Enter the video URL and this tool returns one row: title, views, likes, comment count, upload date and description.

Method / toolPricing modelNotes
This tool (DataForSEO)Pay per request. About $0.006 (measured)One video's views, likes, comments, date and description in a row. Save as CSV
The YouTube watch page (by hand)FreeAlways available. You see the numbers, but copy them yourself
vidIQFree plan plus paid Boost and MAX (its pricing page lists Boost $19/month and MAX $49/month)Has video analysis screens (see the official site for features). A channel-running tool
YouTube Data APIFree quota (10,000 units a day); a video lookup costs 1 unitThe official API. Pull numbers at scale if you write code, with setup effort

Checked in November 2026. Prices change — confirm on each vendor's official site before you buy.

Why use this tool

  • Just paste the URL. A video URL or a video ID both work.
  • The description comes along. Keep the title and description next to the numbers.
  • About $0.006. About 160 lookups per $1, so you can log many videos.
  • A few seconds. We measured about 6–7 seconds.
  • Save as CSV. Fetch again later and compare the numbers yourself.

When it is not the right fit

  • You want a trend over time → each result is a snapshot.
  • You want numbers only the owner sees, such as revenue or audience age → they are not shown.
  • You want channel-wide numbers → this is one video per call.
  • You want many videos at once → one per call.
  • You can write code → the official YouTube Data API costs 1 unit per video lookup; use it for large volumes.

This tool does one thing: tabulate the public numbers of one video.

FAQ

Which URL forms work?

watch?v= links, short youtu.be links, Shorts URLs and an 11-character video ID.

Why is there no country or language selector?

The lookup is by video ID. We fix it to Japan and Japanese.

Can a number come back blank?

Anything the API does not return stays blank.

Does the comment count include replies?

We show the API's figure as is; the breakdown is not known.

Can I sign up with a free email address?

No. DataForSEO does not accept free email providers. See What is DataForSEO?

C16.content_en:
Ways to read a video's comments — and how the main options compare

Before you buy stock, you want the real opinions of buyers from the comments under a review video — but scrolling through hundreds of comments one by one is tiring. Enter the video URL and this tool lists the comments: text, likes, reply count and date.

Method / toolPricing modelNotes
This tool (DataForSEO)Pay per request. About $0.002 for 20 comments, about $0.01 for 100 (measured)Comment text, likes, replies and date in a table. Save as CSV, then search and sort
YouTube comment section (by hand)FreeScroll and read on screen. Copying and saving is up to you
vidIQFree plan plus paid Boost and MAX (its pricing page lists Boost $19/month and MAX $49/month)A channel-running tool. How it handles comments: see the official site
YouTube Data APIFree quota (10,000 units a day); fetching comments costs 1 unitThe official API. Pull comments at scale if you write code, with setup effort

Checked in November 2026. Prices change — confirm on each vendor's official site before you buy.

Why use this tool

  • Comment text in a table. Save as CSV and search a spreadsheet for words like "broke" or "never arrived".
  • Likes and replies attached. See which comments struck a chord.
  • A few seconds. About 6–7 seconds for 20 comments and about 7 for 100 (measured).
  • About $0.01 for 100. Read a hundred comments from one video in one go.
  • Dated. Tell old comments from recent ones.

When it is not the right fit

  • You want every comment → up to 100 per call. A video with millions of comments still returns only the number you choose.
  • You want to know which comments are honest → the tool just lays the comments out.
  • You need a specific order → comments come in the order the API returns, not necessarily by likes.
  • You want reply text → the reply count is shown, not the replies.
  • You can write code → the official YouTube Data API costs 1 unit per comment request; use it for large volumes.

This tool does one thing: lay out one video's comments and their numbers.

FAQ

Can I fetch more than 100?

This version offers 20, 50 or 100.

Why is the date not shown like "7 years ago"?

We use the timestamp and show a date.

May I reuse other people's comments?

Comments belong to their authors. This table is for reading trends; respect the rights of the author and the video owner if you quote.

Why is there no country or language selector?

The lookup is by video ID. We fix it to Japan and Japanese.

Can I sign up with a free email address?

No. DataForSEO does not accept free email providers. See What is DataForSEO?
